kurz: Starch on the surface has glued the pasta together, usually in the first few minutes or after draining.
bild_im_kopf: Like stamps lying damp on top of each other.

ursachen.warum: In the first few minutes the surface is at its stickiest.
fix: Stir several times in the first two minutes

ursachen.titel: Water not at a rolling boil
ursachen.warum: Without movement the pasta lies against itself.
fix: Bring the water to a rolling boil before the pasta goes in

q1.frage: Was the pasta already sticking in the pot?

q2.frage: Was the water at a rolling boil when the pasta went in?
